comparison.objective: Stand and secure a gas cylinder in a bench clamp; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires handling a large unstable bottle, translating a cross bolt and closing a cam lever. Candidate requires recessed key alignment and small collar/set-screw manipulation with iterative tests.
comparison.success_condition: Record checks bottle tilt/offset, bolt travel, lever angle, stillness and release. Candidate checks two impact cycles and no bottoming or drift, though several thresholds are undeclared.
comparison.reason: Static load securing with a cam clamp is materially different from dynamic damping adjustment.
